title: Report System Plugin
description: Easily report players with a single command and notify the admins directly.
body:
✨ Features

**Interactive GUI:** Players can easily select reasons with a click instead of typing lengthy commands.

**Fully Customizable:** Change all messages, GUI elements (items, slots, titles), and report reasons in the config.yml file. **Most of this is congicurable on the newest Version, more coming soon!**

**Real-Time Notifications:** Your team will be instantly notified in chat when a new report is received.

**Asynchronous Saving:** All reports are saved in a reports.txt file without impacting server performance.

**Persistent Data:** Utilizes modern Bukkit interfaces (PDC) for maximum stability.

🛠️ **Commands & Permissions**

🖥️ **Commands:**

/report <report|reload> <player>
- /report report <player> | Opens the report menu for the target player of any player
- /report reload | Reloads and applies all changes from the config.yml file.

🛠️ **Permissions:**

report.admin **Get's Permission to /report reload**
report.notify **Get's the Report Notifications**

🎲 **More Options and configs coming soon!**
